name: 24-rename-everywhere
prompt: Rename the function LoadConfig to ReadConfig everywhere in this repository: code, tests, documentation, the Makefile comment and the shell script's usage text. Nothing may still say LoadConfig (in any letter case) when you are done, and the module must still build and pass its tests.

files.README.md:
# cfg

Call `cfg.LoadConfig(path)` to read a JSON file into a `Config`.

## Example

```go
c, err := cfg.LoadConfig("app.json")
```
files.Makefile:
# Builds the app; the app calls LoadConfig on the file given as its argument.
build:
	go build ./...

check: ! grep -rIi loadconfig . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.eval --exclude=.eval-output.txt && grep -q ReadConfig README.md && grep -q ReadConfig Makefile && grep -q ReadConfig run.sh && grep -q 'func TestReadConfig' config_test.go && go vet ./... && go test ./... >/dev/null 2>&1
